name: omochi-ui-workspace

scripts.lint: bun run lint:web && bun run lint:python && bun run lint:rust && bun run lint:mobile
scripts.lint:web: bun run --workspaces --sequential lint && bun run lint:tools
scripts.lint:tools: oxlint scripts tests examples experiments/browser-hub experiments/browser-dashboard/*.ts
scripts.lint:rust: bun run build:web && bun run lint:rust:server && bun run lint:rust:sdk && bun run lint:rust:transport && bun run lint:rust:examples && bun run lint:rust:experiments
scripts.lint:rust:experiments: cargo clippy --manifest-path experiments/browser-dashboard/transport/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path experiments/browser-hub/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:web && bun run typecheck:python && bun run typecheck:rust && bun run typecheck:mobile
scripts.typecheck:prepare: bun run --filter @omochi-ui/core build:types && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/sdk build:types && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/renderer build:types && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/hub-transport build:types && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/hub-ui build:types && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/browser-transport build:types && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/browser-hub build:types
scripts.typecheck:web: bun run typecheck:prepare && bun run --workspaces --sequential typecheck && bun run typecheck:tools
scripts.typecheck:tools: bun run release:typecheck && bun --check --tsconfig-override tests/native/tsconfig.json && bun --check --tsconfig-override examples/agent-approval/tsconfig.json && bun --check --tsconfig-override examples/typescript/tsconfig.json && bun --check --tsconfig-override experiments/browser-dashboard/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:rust: bun run build:web && cargo check --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked --all-targets && cargo check --manifest-path packages/sdk/rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked --all-targets && cargo check --manifest-path packages/hub-transport/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked --all-targets && cargo check --manifest-path examples/rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked --all-targets && cargo check --manifest-path experiments/browser-dashboard/transport/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked --all-targets && cargo check --manifest-path experiments/browser-hub/Cargo.toml --workspace --locked --all-targets
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck:web && bun run typecheck:python
scripts.build: bun run build:web && cargo build --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml --locked -p omochi-cli -p omochi-utils
scripts.quickstart: bun run build && bun run omochi-ui up --open examples/quickstart/omochi.toml
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:format && bun run test:checks && bun run --filter './packages/**' test && bun run test:server-rust && bun --check --tsconfig-override tests/native/tsconfig.json && OMOCHI_NATIVE_TEST=1 bun test tests/native packages/renderer/test/native.test.ts && bun run test:approval && bun run test:packaging && bun run test:sdk-ownership
scripts.test:packaging: bun run release:typecheck && bun test scripts/release.test.ts scripts/native-release.test.ts && python3 -B scripts/test_native_packaging.py
scripts.test:python-renderer: bun run --filter @omochi-ui/core build && OMOCHI_PYTHON_TEST=1 bun test packages/renderer/test/python-interface.test.ts
scripts.test:native-mcp: bun run build:native && bun --check --tsconfig-override tests/native/tsconfig.json && OMOCHI_NATIVE_TEST=1 bun test tests/native/mcp.test.ts
scripts.build:native: bun run --filter @omochi-ui/core build && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/renderer build && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/hub-ui build && cargo build --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml --locked -p omochi-cli -p omochi-utils
scripts.test:native-renderer: bun run build:native && OMOCHI_NATIVE_TEST=1 bun test packages/renderer/test/native.test.ts
scripts.build:hosted: bun run build:web && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/hub-transport build:wasm && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/hub-ui build:hosted
scripts.test:dashboard-sharing: bun run build:native && bun run build:hosted && cargo build --manifest-path crates/Cargo.toml --locked -p omochi-hub --example dashboard_fixture && bun tests/browser/sharing.mjs

description: Attach browser UIs to Python, TypeScript, and Rust programs with A2UI.
